CommunityApplications.Profile:
Mains Power Monitor uses a mains-powered Raspberry Pi (for example a Pi-hole host) as a proxy for mains/network availability while Unraid stays UPS-backed. After a configurable number of failed pings it records the outage and triggers Unraid's native clean shutdown, then sends one Warning-level recovery notification once connectivity returns on a later boot. This repository contains the single Mains Power Monitor plugin.
Support and bug reports: https://github.com/RayMunro/unraid-mains-power-monitor/issues
